top_signal.title: Small brands: who did you use for low-volume premium custom packaging?
top_signal.summary: I’m developing a new premium collectible product and am trying to figure out the packaging/manufacturing side before launch.   I already have a fairly developed packaging concept, so I’m less interested in hiring a branding agency and more interested in finding a company that can help turn the concept into an actual manufacturable rigid box, custom insert and physical prototype.   The product itself is a small precious-metal collectible, roughly 42 mm × 29 mm, so the package isn’t large. But presentation is important, and I want the packaging to feel substantial rather than like a generic jewelry box.   I’m looking for:   • premium rigid box  • custom fitted insert/cradle  • high-quality matte materials  • embossing/debossing and/or foil  • space for authentication documents  • exterior identification so multiple releases look good displayed together  • the ability to reuse the basic package architecture for future editions   The difficult part is volume. I’d ideally like to start with 1–3 really good prototypes, then perhaps 25–100 boxes for the first production run rather than ordering thousands before the product has been tested in the market.   For other small-business owners who have done premium packaging, who did you use and what did you learn?   I’m particularly interested in companies that will actually help with structural engineering, insert development and prototyping, rather than simply printing an existing dieline.
